subject: Reference-modification
notes: kb/Work PB70 + PB73 (2026-08-18): a usage-DISPLAY item of a category other than alphanumeric is OPERATED UPON for reference modification as if redefined class-and-category alphanumeric of the same size — the rule governs the OPERATION (positions are the character positions of that redefinition: a numeric-DISPLAY item's digit/sign characters, an edited item's characters, an alphabetic or display-form boolean item's characters), while GR6 gives the RESULT its class and category (PB73 re-adjudicated PB72's reading, which had made every such view alphanumeric — the display-form boolean slice stays boolean and the alphabetic slice alphabetic). RefModPlace.CategoryOf is the ONE reader.
